name: Naomi Inoue
source: Hanako's classmate and member of Yamaku's newspaper club, Naomi has severe epilepsy and deals with seizures on a regular basis. Her classmates note that although she's a very helpful person, her loud antics and upbeat personality are a bit tiring to be around sometimes, a foil to her stern and serious friend and clubmate [url=https://vndb.org/c149258]Natsume[/url].
